name: [WORLD 2 🐉] Anime Incremental
desc:
Welcome to Anime Incremental! A massive Incremental game with tons of Upgrades, powerful Cards, Prestige layers, Skill Trees, and Adventures to explore! ✨

🏆 Rank up and become the ultimate Shinobi!
